VERSION 3.27.x.x
VERSION 3.28.x.x
VERSION 3.29.x.x
VERSION 3.30.0.109

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/modules/userfrontend/qml/AccountSettingsWindow.qml
    IMPORT org.xovi.Manager 1.0
    TRAVERSE BaseView#root
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            Loader {
                id: accountManagerLoader
                anchors.fill: parent
                z: 2000
                active: false
                source: "qrc:/xovi/manager/Manager.qml"
                property string ownerId: ""
                property string pageId: ""
                onLoaded: {
                    item.systemNavigator = root.windowNavigator
                    item.initialOwner = ownerId
                    item.entryPoint = "account"
                    item.openEntry(ownerId, pageId, true)
                }
            }
            Connections {
                target: ManagerNavigation
                function onOpenRequested(owner, page, source) {
                    if (source !== "account" || !root.visible) return
                    accountManagerLoader.ownerId = owner
                    accountManagerLoader.pageId = page
                    if (accountManagerLoader.item) {
                        accountManagerLoader.item.refresh()
                        accountManagerLoader.item.openEntry(owner, page, true)
                    } else accountManagerLoader.active = true
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
